title: Influence of pH-induced particle-size modulation on the electrochemical performance of spinel ZnFe2O4 anodes for lithium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15452-15463
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10094A, Paper
Open Access

To Giang Tran, Thi My Dung Ngo, Anh Huy Phan, Hai Dang Ngo, Ngoc Trung Tran, Hieu Trung Bui, Tuan Loi Nguyen, Tran Thi Kieu Ngan, Il Tae Kim, Quang Hung Nguyen
Co-precipitation optimizes ZnFe2O4 particle size via pH adjustment. In detail, the ZFO_pH 11 anode exhibits excellent electrochemical performances, retaining 910.84 mAh g−1 after 60 cycles, demonstrating high potential for Li-ion batteries.
